paras: Cyrtodactylus evanquahi or Evan Quah's banded bent-toed gecko is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Malaysia.
The specific name, evanquahi, is in honor of Malaysian herpetologist Evan Seng Huat Quah.
C. evanquahi is found in northwestern Peninsular Malaysia, in Kedah state.
C. evanquahi may attain a snout-to-vent length of 9.6 cm (3.8 in).
The mode of reproduction of C. evanquahi is unknown.
